proposed.text: Per PD 1096 Rule I, Section 102 (Declaration of Policy), the Code establishes what type of standards framework for buildings and structures?

options.text: Recommended guidelines that designers may adopt at their discretion
Performance targets benchmarked against foreign model codes
Minimum standards and requirements for location, site, design, materials, construction, use, occupancy, and maintenance
Maximum limits that local ordinances may not exceed

proposed.rationale: Section 102 declares that the Code provides a framework of minimum standards and requirements regulating location, site, design, quality of materials, construction, use, occupancy, and maintenance. The word 'minimum' is controlling: a project, contract, local ordinance, or referral code may require more, but the Code establishes the baseline.
proposed.explanation: Treat PD 1096 standards as regulatory minimums. Local ordinances and project specifications may be more restrictive; they cannot validly be less restrictive than the Code baseline.
